content: Satori (the library behind @vercel/og) shapes complex scripts like Arabic via HarfBuzz but does NOT yet support full Unicode bidirectional layout as of 2026 -- an open PR (#745, opened April 2026) to add Arabic/Hebrew RTL rendering was still unmerged. Mixed LTR/RTL text will not match correct browser ordering. Do NOT use satori/@vercel/og for compositing Hebrew captions -- it will silently produce wrong character/word order.
